sources.title: Clips Studio: AI video clipping that runs on your own PC
sources.snippet: Clips Studio runs on your own computer, so it costs nothing to use: no subscription, no credits, no charge per clip, no limit on how many you make. If you have a PC and something worth posting, you can promote your channel without paying anyone, me included. Clipping tools like OpusClip charge a monthly fee or a price per video.
